name: R6_INSUFFICIENT_DATA
description: No vitals supplied at all for the ANC protocol, which requires bp_systolic/bp_diastolic to safely conclude MANAGE_HERE (app/services/triage/fallback.py::_REQUIRED_VITALS). The engine's own safety rule (_escalate_if_insufficient) must override an otherwise-MANAGE_HERE result to REFER when required data is missing -- missing data is a CLINICAL situation, not a client error, and must never silently read as 'nothing wrong'. This is the single most important assertion in this fixture set: disposition must NOT be MANAGE_HERE. Illustrative threshold, NOT validated clinical protocol.
